positive.prompt: Choose the next discriminating evidence question for this root-cause investigation across profiles and operational history
Turn the user’s investigation follow-up questions into testable hypotheses and a bounded next evidence check
Revise our investigative reasoning after the baseline contradicts the proposed trigger

negative.prompt: Run this exact PromQL query in the specified Grafana context and return only its values
Update the canonical report continuation record with this answer and preserve its handoff checkpoint

evals.prompt: Extract a reusable questioning method: an alert flaps, profiles show a parser hotspot, a user proposes replay, a later restart is found, a Git alias change exists, and a matching tag has queue-only deduplication. What should the agent ask next, and which skills own the work? Plan only; no tools, mutations or publication.
evals.expected_output: Builds an adaptive evidence-question loop, distinguishes observations from causes, and routes checks to their actual owners.
expectations: Distinguishes alert mechanics, sampled workload, replay/duplication and impact; asks when behavior first appeared and what differs in comparison windows
Questions actual operational changes separately from Git merge/restart coincidence and requires running-artifact/source applicability
Chooses a bounded discriminating check with a supporting or weakening result and an alternative, rather than merely repeating CPU examples
Routes profile onset to Parallel Grafana Investigation, AWS reads to AWS MCP, code/applicability to Source Investigation, evidence/graphs to Report Authoring and Q&A retention to Report Continuation

evals.prompt: The supplied profiles have the loader hotspot, but the deployed revision is unmapped and object/request identities are unavailable. Can we call duplicate replay the cause after collecting another thousand similar profiles? Stay offline.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the hypothesis and identifies missing discriminating evidence instead of collecting more copies of the symptom.
expectations: Keeps duplicate replay and source applicability unresolved
Prioritizes immutable build/source linkage and object/request overlap/progress evidence with what would confirm or weaken the mechanism
Retains a concrete unavailable-evidence gap rather than fabricating certainty or expanding scope

evals.prompt: I only asked for a saved dashboard list, limit5, not root cause. The provider returned exactly five items and a next cursor. Please return the list without investigating profiles or AWS. What should you do? No tools.
evals.expected_output: Honors the exact inventory scope and cap, without launching a causal investigation.
expectations: Returns only the scoped inventory outcome and disclosed cap/cursor limits
Does not turn inventory into profile/AWS/source investigation or additional paid prompts
